verdict.rationale: Supabase's first-party docs say Storage can 'optimize and resize images on the fly': any image in a bucket can be transformed, with transform options on signed and public URLs and client-library support. That removes the need for a self-run image pipeline, but the feature is gated to the Pro Plan and above. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documented detail on the transform parameters (formats, crop/quality modes), and availability on the free tier.
